notes: You can now drag a follower straight from your hand onto the battlefield to play it, with the card visibly following your finger/cursor and snapping back if you let go somewhere that isn't a valid drop. This also fixes the underlying issue that made playing a card sometimes take two taps instead of one.
fixes: Playing a follower from hand could sometimes need two taps instead of one. Dragging a hand card used to be swallowed by the same gesture system used for reordering your hand, so a drag toward the battlefield often did nothing on the first try. Dragging is now handled consistently end-to-end: drag a card onto the field (or onto your Recovery Skills area) to play it, drag it onto another card in hand to reorder it, and the card now visibly follows your finger/cursor the whole way and snaps back to your hand if released somewhere invalid.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
